findings.text: `hostname[-1]` raises IndexError when the netloc is empty. For example, `URL('/path').replace(port=8000)` or `URL('file:///x').replace(username='a')` now crashes. Before this change it did not, because `self.hostname` was used.

`rsplit(':', 1)[0]` strips whatever follows the last colon, and `hostname` comes from `netloc` with no further checks. The case I traced is a netloc whose last colon is not a port separator, which would lose part of the host. The old `self.hostname` property did not have that problem.
